##### Project general facts

HQ by Rove is a new-generation commercial destination in Dubai, introducing the city’s first hospitality-branded office building by Rove Hotels. Located in the vibrant Marasi Bay area, the project is designed around the idea that the modern workplace should be more flexible, inspiring, and connected to the way businesses operate today. With 23 office floors, panoramic city views, direct access to the Dubai Canal, and excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Business Bay, Dubai Design District, and Sheikh Zayed Road, HQ by Rove creates a premium business address in one of Dubai’s most dynamic locations.

The project offers a diverse collection of fully fitted and furnished office spaces, designed to accommodate businesses of different sizes and stages. The modular office collection ranges from studios starting at approximately 680 sq.ft to larger Deluxe, Executive, and bespoke configurations, with the flexibility to combine units as a company grows. Larger Loft Office options offer double-height ceilings, premium interiors, private kitchenettes, and dedicated washrooms, while selected offices feature private outdoor courtyards.

HQ by Rove is built around a comprehensive business ecosystem rather than simply providing office space. The project features dedicated co-working areas, meeting rooms, communal lounges, café facilities, rooftop spaces, observation decks, garden meeting pods, and social areas designed to encourage productivity, networking, and collaboration. The development also provides extensive parking, EV charging stations, bicycle parking, high-speed destination-controlled elevators, and a dedicated private road entrance, creating a seamless experience from arrival to the working day itself.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is a vibrant and stylish community, known for its trendy atmosphere and cutting-edge gadgets. Located on the south side of Downtown Dubai, this area is a hub of activity, with numerous events and festivals taking place throughout the year, including music festivals, Mother's Day celebrations, and New Year's celebrations. The lifestyle in Business Bay offers a unique blend of excitement and convenience, with famous international schools, medical facilities, supermarkets, banks, and finance centres just a short distance away.

The proximity of these amenities makes Business Bay an ideal location for those seeking a high standard of living, with easy access to a wide range of services and facilities. The area is also known for its stunning residential properties, hotel towers, and amazing restaurants, creating a dynamic and cosmopolitan atmosphere. With its face-paced lifestyle and numerous opportunities for entertainment and leisure, Business Bay is the perfect destination for those seeking a life of excitement and adventure.

Business Bay's unique blend of style, convenience, and entertainment makes it an attractive destination for those seeking a high-quality lifestyle. The area's numerous amenities and services, combined with its vibrant atmosphere, create a truly exceptional living experience. With its stunning properties, world-class facilities, and exciting events, Business Bay is a place where residents can elevate their standard of living and enjoy a life of pleasure, success, and fun.
